about: A cloudtrail policy that sleeps 600 seconds (Custodian's `delay`, for eventual consistency) before looking: the bullet says it runs after the call, and after the delay.

controls.output: - S3 buckets whose `Versioning.Status` isn't `Enabled` are flagged 600 seconds after `CreateBucket`, so a bucket created without versioning is found about 10 minutes later. Versioned buckets pass. MEDIUM, ORG; reports only. acme:s3-versioning-on-create@1
- S3 buckets whose `Versioning.Status` isn't `Enabled` are flagged just after `CreateBucket`. Versioned buckets pass. MEDIUM, ORG; reports only. acme:s3-versioning-on-create@1

- S3 buckets whose `Versioning.Status` isn't `Enabled` are flagged on a scheduled scan every 600 seconds; `CreateBucket` is not involved. Versioned buckets pass. MEDIUM, ORG; reports only. acme:s3-versioning-on-create@1
- S3 buckets whose `Versioning.Status` isn't `Enabled` are blocked 600 seconds after `CreateBucket`. Versioned buckets pass. MEDIUM, ORG; reports only. acme:s3-versioning-on-create@1
